summary: Canadian National Railway Company filed a Form 6-K with its second-quarter 2026 earnings release and unaudited financial statements. The filing reports Q2 2026 results showing revenues of C$4,753 million (up 11% YoY), diluted EPS of C$2.06 (up 10%), and adjusted diluted EPS of C$2.08 (up 11%). The company raised 2026 guidance, now expecting mid-to-high single-digit adjusted diluted EPS growth. CN repurchased approximately 2.9 million shares for C$454 million in Q2 and generated free cash flow of C$1,842 million in H1 2026. This is a routine earnings report with no special-situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or activist campaign.
